title: Superer 65W Laptop Charger Fit for Acer A514-

comparisons.notes: Superer brand, Model ADP190342L, MPN SP-01463, 19V 3.42A 65W for Acer Aspire; in stock and purchasable.

writeup: Superer's 65W replacement charger (model ADP190342L, 19V 3.42A) fits Acer Aspire 1, 3 and 5 laptops such as the A514 and A515-44. Woot has it for $5.99, while Swiftsly sells the same Superer adapter for $21.95. Woot showed only one left when it was spotted.
amazon_match_notes: Matched by ASIN, model ADP190342L, MPN SP-01463 and exact title per verified check.
